flow: Infected Homosexual Men->AIDS Individuals living with AIDS
Infected Women->AIDS Individuals living with AIDS
Infected Heterosexual Men->AIDS Individuals living with AIDS
Treated on ART->AIDS Individuals living with AIDS
param: Ψ Total recruitment rate into the susceptible populations (named C in text).
θ Proportion of new recruits who are men (named h in text).
γ Proportion of new male recruits who are heterosexual (named c in text).
lambda_h Force of infection on susceptible homosexual men from infected homosexual men.
lambda_m Force of infection on susceptible women from infected heterosexual men.
lambda_hw Force of infection on susceptible women from infected homosexual men (bisexual contact).
lambda_w Force of infection on susceptible heterosexual men from infected women.
lambda_hm Force of infection on susceptible heterosexual men from infected homosexual men (bisexual contact).
μ Natural mortality rate for all compartments (named l in text).
α Departure rate from infected compartments, either to treatment or to AIDS (named a in text).
p Proportion of departing infected individuals who start antiretroviral therapy (ART).
δ Rate of progression to AIDS for treated individuals due to treatment failure or resistance (named d in some parts of the text).
Recruitment_Sh Recruitment rate for susceptible homosexual men.
Recruitment_Sw Recruitment rate for susceptible women.
Recruitment_Sm Recruitment rate for susceptible heterosexual men.
Progression_to_T Rate at which infected individuals start treatment.
Progression_to_A Rate at which untreated infected individuals progress directly to AIDS.
